name: freight-tail
prompt: Truck's private static method last(String, int) is only ever called with 4. Replace it with an instance method String tail(String code) of Truck, not private, that keeps the last 4 characters of code, the part a driver sees, and remove last. What Truck's methods return and ship must not change.

name: freight-routes
prompt: Replace the fields road and rail of freight.Shipment with one field public final Map<String, String> routes, keyed by route: "road" for the road depot code and "rail" for the rail yard code. A new Shipment has an empty, mutable map. Everything that used the two fields, in every package, must work as before.
